_about: One source for the privacy policy's 'Your data at a glance' table, its provider table, and /privacy/data.json. scripts/__tests__/privacy-data.test.ts checks that every provider named in privacy.njk is listed here, and every provider here handles at least one kind of data.

processors.name: Google Cloud
processors.does: Hosts Ferni and stores what we keep, encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS)

processors.name: Google (Gemini)
processors.does: Understanding you and writing Ferni's replies; summaries, memory notes and memory search
processors.data: Conversation text, things you've told Ferni, voice notes you ask Ferni to transcribe

processors.name: Anthropic (Claude)
processors.does: Background work such as summaries, memory notes and messages Ferni drafts for you
processors.data: Conversation text, things you've told Ferni

processors.name: OpenAI
processors.does: Backup when our main model is unavailable
processors.data: Conversation text, only when it's used as the backup

processors.name: LiveKit
processors.does: Carries the audio of live calls and runs Ferni's voice service
processors.data: Call audio while you talk, conversation text

processors.name: Cartesia
processors.does: Turns your voice into text and Ferni's replies into speech
processors.data: Your voice during calls, the text of Ferni's replies

processors.name: Twilio
processors.data: Phone number, message content, phone call audio

processors.name: Apple
processors.does: Delivers notifications to the iPhone app, if you allow them
processors.data: Your iPhone's push token, and a short alert that says only what kind of thing is waiting, never what you said

processors.name: Sentry
processors.does: Crash reports from the iPhone app and error reports from our servers, with personal details removed
processors.data: What failed and where in our code, and the kind of phone. Never your account or what you said

processors.name: Google Analytics
processors.does: Website analytics, only if you accept analytics cookies
processors.data: How the website is used, never your conversations

dataTypes.detail: Email, phone number, name, optional photo
dataTypes.why: So you can sign in and Ferni can reach you

dataTypes.detail: Transcripts, summaries, things you've told Ferni, and the search index built from them
dataTypes.why: So Ferni can remember you next time

dataTypes.detail: What you say, and Ferni's spoken replies
dataTypes.why: So Ferni can hear you and answer out loud
dataTypes.kept: We don't record calls. Your words are turned into text as you speak, and the text is kept with your conversations

dataTypes.why: So you can come back to them
dataTypes.kept: Until you delete them or your account

dataTypes.type: Things you ask Ferni to forget
dataTypes.kept: Ferni stops using them right away; they're erased when you delete your account

dataTypes.why: To show your calendar and send email you ask Ferni to send
dataTypes.kept: Until you disconnect them or delete your account

dataTypes.detail: Counts and timings under a scrambled ID, never what you said
dataTypes.why: To see what works and what's slow
dataTypes.kept: Deleted after 400 days. Deleting your account doesn't erase them yet

dataTypes.detail: Only if you accept analytics cookies
dataTypes.kept: Up to 14 months, the longest Google Analytics allows

dataTypes.detail: Only if you allow notifications in the iPhone app
dataTypes.why: Only to deliver Ferni's notifications to your phone

dataTypes.detail: IP address, times, pages and errors

What failed and where in our code. Crash reports from the iPhone app carry no account, name, screenshots or anything you said, and aren't linked to you. Server error reports leave out account details, and emails, phone numbers and what you said are removed
dataTypes.kept: Up to 90 days, then Sentry deletes them
